name: NDF eTIMS Integration
description: Optional Kenya Revenue Authority eTIMS integration for NDF Frappe Platform deployments targeting Frappe v16, using Navari's Kenya Compliance via Slade360 VSCU integration.

notes: Optional capability layered on top of dhana-base-v16.
The capability uses Navari's existing Kenya Compliance via Slade360 integration.
The primary integration uses KRA VSCU through the external Slade360 Advantage service.
csf_ke is a required application dependency of kenya_compliance_via_slade.
Slade360 Advantage is an externally managed integration dependency and must not be included as a bench application or container service.
Resolve all application refs to immutable commit SHAs before producing a production lock.
Production deployment requires valid taxpayer onboarding, Slade360 configuration and applicable KRA integration approval.

applications.name: csf_ke
applications.notes: Navari Kenya Country Specific Functionality application. Provides Kenya-specific ERPNext functionality and is a dependency of kenya_compliance_via_slade.

applications.name: kenya_compliance_via_slade
applications.notes: Primary eTIMS integration application. Uses Slade360 Advantage as the intermediary for KRA VSCU integration. Requires external Slade360 onboarding, credentials and configuration.
